name: PROMIS Fatigue Short Form 8a
developer: PROMIS Health Organization and PROMIS Cooperative Group (Cella et al., 2010)
construct: Experience of fatigue and its interference with daily activities over the past 7 days.
licence: HealthMeasures Terms of Use: all English and Spanish versions of PROMIS and Neuro-QoL "are publicly available for use without licensing or royalty fees for individual research or individual clinical use." Copyright line on the form: "© 2008-2012 PROMIS Health Organization and PROMIS Cooperative Group". Since 2024 licence fees apply to translations and to vendor platforms; confirm current terms on Steps to License.
sourceUrl: https://psytests.org/diag/promF8en-bl.html (English item text) and https://heal.nih.gov/files/CDEs/2023-07/promis-fatigue-8a-crf.pdf (item codes, response values, copyright; Spanish Universal version)
instructions: Please respond to each question or statement by marking one box per row. During the past 7 days...

items.note: Item code HI7; response set Not at all to Very much (1-5)

items.text: I have trouble starting things because I am tired.
items.note: Item code AN3; response set Not at all to Very much (1-5)

items.text: How run-down did you feel on average?
items.note: Item code FATEXP41; response set Not at all to Very much (1-5)

items.text: How fatigued were you on average?
items.note: Item code FATEXP40; response set Not at all to Very much (1-5)

items.text: How much were you bothered by your fatigue on average?
items.note: Item code FATEXP35; response set Not at all to Very much (1-5)

items.text: To what degree did your fatigue interfere with your physical functioning?
items.note: Item code FATIMP49; response set Not at all to Very much (1-5)

items.text: How often did you have to push yourself to get things done because of your fatigue?
items.note: Item code FATIMP3; response set Never, Rarely, Sometimes, Often, Always (1-5); stem "In the past 7 days..."

items.text: How often did you have trouble finishing things because of your fatigue?
items.note: Item code FATIMP16; response set Never, Rarely, Sometimes, Often, Always (1-5); stem "In the past 7 days..."

scoring: Sum the 8 item responses (each 1 to 5) to give a raw score of 8 to 40, then convert the raw score to a T score (mean 50, SD 10 in the US general population) using the HealthMeasures scoring table for Fatigue 8a Adult v1.0 or the HealthMeasures Scoring Service; higher T scores indicate more fatigue. HealthMeasures descriptive bands for symptom measures: below 55 within normal limits, 55 to 59.9 mild, 60 to 69.9 moderate, 70 and above severe.

transcriptionNote: The HealthMeasures measure library (itemsUrl) returned no measure pages or PDF links to WebFetch. English item text was transcribed from the psytests.org reproduction, which is not an official form, carries no copyright line and shows response labels without numeric values. Item codes (HI7, AN3, FATEXP41, FATEXP40, FATEXP35, FATIMP49, FATIMP3, FATIMP16), the 1 to 5 values, the 2 response sets (items 1 to 6 intensity, items 7 to 8 frequency), the instruction sentence and the copyright line were confirmed from the NIH HEAL case report form, which is the Spanish Universal version of the same 8a form; the English instruction sentence given here is the standard PROMIS wording matching that Spanish sentence and the English MAPP PROMIS Fatigue form ("Please respond to each question by marking one box per row."). The psytests page prints the stem as "During the past 7 days..." before item 1 and "In the past 7 days..." before item 7. The response labels for items 3 to 6 were inferred from the single label row printed above items 1 and 2 on both sources. Verify against the official HealthMeasures PDF before clinical use.
